ServingLease.description:
Finite serving lease for one node incarnation (§16.3, §9.2, §15.3).

Server rules: `expires_at` (node_lease_end) is at most `issued_at +
max_offline_seconds`. For each member, `lease_end` (member_lease_end) =
min(issued_at + max_offline_seconds, effective_service_end, expires_at).
Members whose effective_service_end is not after issued_at, or who are
suspended, are omitted. A lease never extends any entitlement deadline.

Node rules: verify the envelope, node and incarnation. Keep the highest
accepted issued_at and reject older leases. Compute local deadlines from
elapsed monotonic time, anchored conservatively at the moment the renewal
request was sent: deadline = t_sent + (lease_end - issued_at). Replaying a
known lease_id never restarts its time; reboot, lost time anchor or clock
anomalies keep member forwarding off until a new lease is applied. The
forwarding deadline is min(effective_service_end, member lease_end),
enforced per packet by kernel timeouts before any broad
established/related accept.

authorization_generation.description: Authorization policy generation the member list was computed from.

config_generation.description: Desired-state generation the lease belongs to.

max_offline_seconds.description:
Seconds copied from fleet configuration at issuance or renewal (§16.3).
A later `PUT /admin/fleet-config` does not rewrite this field. 86400 is
the ceiling and the recommended default.
